process: Two coding agents independently labeled the original Dutch notes for the same fixed targets without extractor predictions. Agent A translated; agent B then reviewed all A translations. Root adjudicated before inference. Agents share the assistant model family; this is not human or clinical expert gold.

translation_review.delivery: Review findings delivered in agent message and transcribed here by root; the original blind label review is preserved per record.
translation_review.all_other_translations: Reviewer B reported source assistance, modality and event scope preserved.
translation_review.evidence_policy: Choose the minimal contiguous full sentence(s) needed for event and assistance attribution. If support is in a later sentence, include intervening text. For unclear assistance on an actual walk, quote the walking/device sentence; when no completed target walk is documented, no evidence is required. Different defensible span sets can fail this strict metric.
